name: Weequay blaster lance
description: The Weequay blaster lance, also known as an long-barreled blaster rifle, was a scoped blaster rifle whose lengthy barrel could be fitted with a bayonet. It was used by several members of Hondo Ohnaka's pirate gang and carried by several bounty hunters, including Cato Parasitti and Twazzi. The IG-86 sentinel droids HELIOS-3D and HELIOS-3E also carried these rifles.
